basics.name: Mohamed Shamil Abdul Salam
basics.label: Software Engineer | Backend Systems | Payments & Fintech
basics.summary: Software Engineer focused on backend systems and financial workflows, with hands-on experience in Laravel, PHP, MySQL, REST APIs, background processing, webhooks, and third-party integrations. Experienced in building and supporting payment, payroll, banking, and accounting workflows with a focus on reliability, data integrity, authorization, and production debugging.

work.name: Zil Money
highlights: Designed and implemented a service-provider access layer (delegated access) across 450 existing REST endpoints, 7 payment services, and 38 webhook event types, with every call audited and payments assigned to the customer’s own approvers kept out of providers’ reach.

Hardened multi-level payment approvals by recording a destination fingerprint at payment creation, re-validating 3 bank fields at release, restricting 3 payee/bank edit paths while payments were pending, and handling approval refusals across 4 entry points.

Strengthened recurring-payment safeguards across 5 payment types and 4 deletion paths, preventing execution against deleted destinations and correcting bulk-cancellation behavior across selected schedules.
Built per-call cost, token, and latency tracking for 16 AI features across 18 call sites, with a dashboard breaking down usage, spend, and failures by feature, model, and provider account.

Extended payroll-provider PDF processing to split merged payroll PDFs into per-check documents and defer check creation until user confirmation, and contributed to automated column mapping for bulk payment imports.

Analyzed a customer’s SAP check-file format and built the full flow around it: parsing, import, background printing, and a custom two-up legal check layout aligned to their pre-printed stock; also moved wallet-statement exports over 1,000 transactions to background processing with PDF, CSV, and XLSX delivery.

Maintained Positive Pay fraud-prevention file generation for 17 banks across CSV, XLSX, and TXT formats, and fixed a time-zone bug that silently skipped file runs scheduled after about 8 PM US Eastern.

Supported the company’s SOC 1 audit by tracing application-side controls, including identity verification, access control, payment validation, and account closure, to their evidence in the system and writing read-only queries to produce populations and samples for the auditors.

work.name: Netplex Solutions
highlights: Analyzed and worked across a Laravel and MySQL business management platform serving customers in Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, tracing routes, controllers, models, Blade views, roles, database structures, and interconnected business modules.

Contributed to the redesign of the platform using Laravel, PHP, PostgreSQL, Inertia, Vue, TypeScript, and Vite, while gathering requirements from new clients and translating business needs into modular application workflows.

Independently developed and investigated the ZATCA e-invoicing workflow up to handover, covering invoice XML generation, signing, hashing, QR-code TLV generation, certificate handling, validation, and investigation of compliance failures.

work.name: Inker Robotics
highlights: Supported web development, usability improvements, testing, documentation, and technical training programs, including session assistance, assessments, and documentation of outcomes.

work.name: Cert-Ed Academia
highlights: Managed internal documentation, digital assets, financial records, and operational materials while maintaining organized administrative workflows.
Calculated class and working hours and prepared salary and fee amounts, while coordinating business materials including letterheads, receipts, posters, and other organizational documents.

projects.name: Cert-Ed Academia
highlights: Developed a 5-role education platform covering classes, assignments, grading, per-session attendance, hours-based billing, receipts, payslips, messaging, and scheduling.
Enforced access through 18 application-level capabilities and 50+ PostgreSQL row-level security policies, supported by 100+ unit tests and per-role database checks in CI.

projects.name: Masaar
highlights: Building an e-invoicing system for electronic invoice generation, signing, QR processing, and certificate management; generated invoices pass ZATCA’s official validator (26 checks).

projects.name: Athar
highlights: Prototyping a security runtime with a Rust service and PHP/Laravel adapter that links payment events into lifecycles, records decision reasoning, and maintains a hash-chained, signed audit log.

projects.name: Time
highlights: Built a work-hours tracker used daily by 10+ colleagues and evolved it into a serverless multi-user service with hourly data synchronization.

quickView.role: Software Engineer · Backend systems · Financial workflows
quickView.line: I build backend systems for financial workflows, where a mistake costs money or trust: who can act on an account, payments that must go where they were approved, and compliance. Laravel and TypeScript, with tests and logs to prove it works.

results.text: Providers work through the existing payment APIs with single-use keys, every call audited and every refusal identical.
Bank details are locked in at submission and re-checked before money moves.
XML generation, signing, hashing, QR codes and compliance-error investigation, developed up to handover.
